title: Multiple high-clearance sources say UAP is a real phenomenon

tellings.quote: One thing I've learned over the last year, I've heard from a whole bunch of people, totally separate sources with like very, very high security clearances, and I mean very high.

plain: Many people with very high security clearances, from completely separate sources, are said to have said that UAP, the official term for UFOs (unidentified anomalous phenomena), are real. The economist Tyler Cowen tells Michels in 2022 that he heard this over the past year, which would mean people with inside access take the subject seriously.
